definitions.explanation: A counter for cups, glasses, bowls, and spoonfuls of liquid or food served in such containers.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{杯|ぱい}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: いっぱい with small っ and ぱ

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{杯|はい}⟦{飲|の}みます→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drink two glasses of water every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{杯|ばい}⟦{食|た}べました→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate three bowls of ramen.
examples.notes: さんばい with voiced ば

examples.japanese: ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{杯|ぱい}⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like another cup of tea?

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦ごはん→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{杯|はい}⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{杯|ぱい}⟦{飲|の}みました→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: After dinner, I drank two bowls of miso soup and also one cup of coffee.

notes:
{杯|はい} is a counter for drinks and servings in cups, glasses, or bowls.

WHAT IT COUNTS:
- Cups of coffee/tea
- Glasses of water/juice
- Bowls of rice/soup/noodles
- Spoonfuls

PRONUNCIATION CHART:
- ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{杯|ぱい} (ippai)
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{杯|はい} (nihai)
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{杯|ばい} (sanbai)
- ⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧{杯|はい} (yonhai)
- ⟦{六|ろっ}→六：00747_roku⟧{杯|ぱい} (roppai)
- ⟦{八|はっ}→八：00698_hachi⟧{杯|ぱい} (happai)
- ⟦{十|じゅっ}→十：00708_juu⟧{杯|ぱい} (juppai)
- ⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧{杯|ばい}: how many cups?

RELATED WORDS:
⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧ can also mean 'full' or 'a lot'.
